# Standard Markdown Elements

This fixture exercises the standard Markdown elements the Renderer must
support (Req 3.1): headings, paragraphs, ordered and unordered lists, tables,
blockquotes, and links.

## Section One

A paragraph of prose that contains an inline
[link to the example domain](https://example.com/docs) so link rendering is
covered.

### A Deeper Subsection

Another paragraph so multiple heading levels are present in the document.
